title: 88Vape Original Tobacco Nut 10ml E-Liquid
description: Tobacco Nut from 88Vape’s Anytank series is a High-PG e-liquid that seamlessly blends the deep, warm flavours of toasted tobacco with the rich, comforting notes of roasted nuts, particularly hazelnut. This e-liquid offers a mature and complex taste profile that is both luxurious and grounded. The tobacco provides a robust and authentic base, while the nutty overtones add a layer of indulgence, making for an exceptionally satisfying vape. This High-PG e-liquid from 88Vape offers a classic vape experience with its tactile and satisfying throat hit and intense flavour delivery. Its 70%PG/30VG content makes it ideal for low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits and pod kits. We would not recommend using High-PG e-liquids with sub-ohm coils and more powerful vape devices. 88Vape are one of the most popular and bestselling vape brands in the UK. They have helped countless smokers make the switch to the far safer alternative of vaping with the help of delicious e-liquids at wallet-friendly prices.
